methodology.objective: Maximize the weaker of train and validation performance after 2x costs
methodology.noLookahead: Signals use closed hour t; entries use hour t+1 open
methodology.universe: Frozen 20-symbol production universe with point-in-time liquidity filtering

costModel.note: Costs are charged on actual target-weight turnover; funding is unavailable

requirements: At least 50% of parameter-family variants profitable in train and validation at 2x costs
Frozen test profitable with profit factor above 1 at 1x and 2x costs
Frozen test max drawdown better than -20%

caveats: The symbol list is today's production universe, so delisted losers are absent (survivorship bias)
Historical funding rates are not available in the local cache
Market impact is approximated by elevated all-in costs rather than order-book replay
A positive backtest is not a guarantee of future profit
